title: Ford - 2024 F-150 Lightning Technical Specifications (PDF, copy on F150LightningForum)
notes: Wheels (Pro/XLT/Flash/Lariat/Platinum): 18 in on Pro; 20 in on XLT, Flash, Lariat; 22 in on Platinum (22 in matte black optional). Battery: SR on Pro and XLT; ER on Flash, Lariat, Platinum (Pro fleet only).
